headline: Contested Sectors Register Fresh Base Movement
war_summary: The latest ledger records a fluid but uneven front. Callums Cape remains the busiest sector, with 44 base events in 24 hours and two in the latest window; its line now shows four Warden-held and three Colonial-held bases. Mooring County has reached 31 daily events, including five recent, while Wardens retain 10 of 12 positions. Linn Mercy has likewise stayed active, posting four events in two hours and 31 across the day; ownership now stands at seven Colonial, three Warden and one neutral base. Weathered Expanse reports seven fresh events and 18 daily, with six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral bases. Marban Hollow has 13 events in 24 hours, though none in the latest two-hour spell, amid sharply rising casualty and enlistment rates. Stonecradle, which was lively in the preceding edition, has recorded no new event in two hours but nine across the day. Elsewhere, Nevish Line and Godcrofts retain earlier churn but are presently quiet. The heaviest current casualty pressure is concentrated in Callums Cape, Linn Mercy, Mooring County and Weathered Expanse.
